description: This file provides utility functions to generate and retrieve the User-Agent string for Playwright, including OS detection, environment info, and embedder details.

methods.name: getUserAgent
methods.description: Returns the cached User-Agent string or determines it if not cached.

methods.name: determineUserAgent
methods.description: Constructs the User-Agent string based on OS and environment info.

methods.name: getEmbedderName
methods.description: Returns the name and version of the embedder environment.

methods.name: getPlaywrightVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the Playwright version, optionally major and minor only.
